summary: A navigation trail, plain or in a bordered card, with three sizes and two separator styles.

props.name: items
props.description: Each item's `label`, `href`, optional `icon` and `iconOnly`. The last item is always rendered as the current page - a plain span with `aria-current="page"`, never a link - regardless of whether it has an `href`.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Wraps the trail in a bordered card.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. Only visible when `bordered` is set.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on the card. Only visible when `bordered` is set.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the trail's classes, for anything the component leaves unset - a margin, `fs-0` in a flex row. It will not reliably override what the component already sets: which of two utilities wins is decided by the stylesheet's rule order, not by the order you write them. Use `size` for the dimensions.
